protocol.central_claim: history-only local T site design improves actual local discrimination, tested rather than assumed
protocol.model: three-terminal linear squared-drop; one known common source direction; P only; no AC
protocol.local_reference: minimum normalized distance to box midpoint; interval overlap with tolerance breaks lexicographically
protocol.committee: uniform average of per-reference minimum rival squared scores; design weights only
protocol.certificate: exact rational feasible QP upper; convex tangent plus box-corrected outer LP dual lower
protocol.evaluation: unchanged v6 full common-source joint LP with exact rational primal/dual certificates

design.committee_semantics: equal design weights, not topology probabilities
